basic_info.description: Only one residence remains! Welcome to Potrero Modern. Behind its commanding, meticulously restored facade, Residence 790 offers its residents sophisticated, thoughtful luxury.This sleek house-like TIC, in a two-unit association (fast-track conv. eligible), boasts a modern open floor plan, a custom kitchen w/ a professional-grade appliance suite, an office area, and a family/ media room. The moody family room /entertaining space offers direct access to the deeded, two-level garden complete w/ lush greenery, LED lighting, and a mature tree canopy, providing both shade & privacy. Ideally situated near the Potrero Recreation Center, Avalon Dog Park, The Good Life Grocery, and with easy access to the 101 & 280, the location is designed for ultimate convenience. Other features include keypad entry to the shared building lobby & the residence front door, two-vehicle parking, Nest climate control, & Ring Video entry. See more at: HomesOnArkansas.com
